gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-duploya: Noto Sans Duployan has a wide-mouthed lowercase a and oversized counters, which give the sans-serif text a generous, contemporary look. Starborn's loose spacing drifts above it.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Ethereal spacing defines Starborn, with a dark band of lowercase running through each line of the heading. But Noto Sans Gothic fills its counters like drilled glass beads, so a long stretch of text reads in open, rounded forms.

gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Dreamy and spaced out, Starborn sits up top. Noto Sans Kaithi grounds the page below with an open-channelled e and lowercase that fills each line like capitals.
